label_provenance.method: source read; sink reachability and escaping checked at the reported line
label_provenance.caveat: Labels were produced by the same agent that built the pipeline. These metrics are NOT independent validation of Laya and must not be cited as such.
label_provenance.label_unit: lane name (one of the 8 Laya lanes), not a yes/no escalation flag

known_limitations: FALSE NEGATIVES ARE NOT MEASURED: false_escalation_rate=0.0 only means nothing was escalated that should not have been. It says nothing about the 4 true positives Laya routed to low_priority.

All 4 true positives (missing subresource-integrity on a third-party CDN) were routed to low_priority. Laya has no signal for third-party script provenance, so the one finding class that matters most is the one it misses.
4 false positives were still escalated to human_review because their probability distribution was not dominant.
expected lanes were derived from the same source reading as the security verdict, so verdict and lane are not independent judgements.
n=29 on a single project. These numbers are not a general accuracy estimate.
